selection_principle: Promote the highest-value unblocked item that reduces decision-critical uncertainty, blocks downstream work, and can be investigated from available evidence without inventing rules.

items.title: Post-SIG lifecycle after reference destruction
items.why_now: The invalidation-aware re-anchor collapsed the inherited-run sample and made the prior Daily-side support no longer current confirmation. The unresolved question of reset versus older-origin re-evaluation directly controls active inherited-state construction and blocks defensible continuation of remaining-run research.
items.preferred_method: Review the five local video+transcript sources first; inspect synchronized visual windows; use audio crosscheck only where ASR wording is material; run targeted threshold-free computation only if multiple source-compatible lifecycle interpretations remain.
items.closure_summary: Source supports a per-SIG/multi-instance lifecycle: the destroyed SIG stops/not-counted; other independent valid references may remain; new confirmed SIGs create new instances; run completion is a separate terminal condition. Generic same-TF newest-to-older fallback remains unresolved.

items.title: PAT2/PAT3 exact geometry and 50% measurement basis
items.why_now: Reliable PA/PAT detection depends on the exact 50% reference, equality behavior, and middle-candle geometry. Current PAT2 BODY success is a research representation, not canonical source geometry.
items.closure_summary: PAT2/PAT3 topology and strict >half semantics are source-backed; exact denominator, combined-candle arithmetic, Doji/small-body/equal-wick and tick-equality tolerances remain explicit parameters/unknowns.

items.title: Daily Frame and Location exact construction semantics
items.why_now: BUY-at-support and SELL-at-resistance semantics are confirmed, but exact measurable Daily Frame/Location construction remains incomplete. Downstream entry studies need a defensible geometric representation.
depends_on: RQ-002 if PA geometry is required by the source example being decoded
items.closure_summary: 07:00 Daily Frame construction using nearby 0/5 statistical reference and +/-500 project points is source-backed; snap/tie, PAT-to-frame interaction/tolerance and cross-family priority remain parameterized.

items.title: M5 brake and frame-standing state machine
items.why_now: Existing evidence establishes a qualitative zone-first stopping/reversal process, but measurable transition features remain incomplete. This is important for turning source language into replayable entry context.
depends_on: RQ-003 for reliable zone/location context where required
items.closure_summary: Zone-first M1/M5 brake state machine, retest preference, frame-standing observation and structure-confirmation features are source-backed; exact numeric force/tolerance gates remain parameterized.

items.title: Sideway construction, completion, and transition to new SIG
items.why_now: Sideway is repeatedly referenced as a market state, but its explicit boundaries and transition/completion semantics remain incomplete. Incorrect sideway state would contaminate setup eligibility and lifecycle interpretation.
items.closure_summary: Sideway lifecycle and handoff to a new SIG are source-backed at state level; exact upper/lower construction, frame-complete geometry and false-break tolerance remain unresolved.

items.title: Por Chon remaining boundary and old-frame lifecycle details
items.why_now: Core 19:00 cutoff and >1000 high-selection semantics are source-backed, but exact H4 inclusion, equality/tie handling, and old-frame retirement remain open. These should be closed before using Por Chon as a deterministic production frame state.
items.closure_summary: Daily 19:00 cutoff, highest fully-known pre-cutoff H4 high, strict >1000 new-frame condition and persistence of older Por Chon frame instances are source-backed; exact bar-label inclusion, ties, retirement priority and body-standing geometry remain partial.

items.title: Entry, SL, and invalidation geometry
items.why_now: Entry/SL proof should be downstream of setup, state, and location semantics. Current evidence includes example-specific relations but not a complete universal execution rule.
items.closure_summary: SIG_ENTRY and FRAME_BRAKE_ENTRY are source-backed distinct families, but universal SL and several exact entry/invalidation geometries remain incomplete; full-system trade outcomes are not yet source-faithfully measurable.

items.title: Full-system replay and out-of-sample Win/Loss proof
items.why_now: This is the final validation layer and must not begin while upstream rules are still being represented by unresolved proxies.
items.closure_summary: Full-system Win/Loss proof is not testable without hidden assumptions because complete trade construction remains unresolved and previously used DEV/VAL/TEST periods are not a pristine final holdout for a newly frozen full-system rule set.

conditional_infrastructure.title: Compact research status widget
conditional_infrastructure.activation_rule: Build when it does not interrupt a decision-critical research closure, or when observability becomes a practical blocker for the project owner.
conditional_infrastructure.purpose: Show current active worksheet, phase, latest checkpoint, blocker, and last result in a small translucent top-right panel.

promotion_rule: On active closure, first re-rank remaining items using the new evidence. Then promote the highest-value unblocked item; do not blindly increment the numeric ID if the dependency picture changed.
guard: The queue organizes research; it does not grant permission to invent thresholds, upgrade provenance from outcomes, or treat historical proxy results as canonical rules.
reopen_rule: Create/reopen a bounded research item only when new source evidence, new labeled examples, a frozen execution specification, or a genuinely untouched holdout materially resolves a named blocker.
reopen_reason: Current local video/transcript batch contains previously under-extracted direct source evidence for SIG entry modes, structural SL references, post-SIG body validity, and point-check destruction.
